title: πFS
summary: πFS (Pi File System) is a satirical/paradoxical file system that claims to store files by finding their binary content within the infinite decimal digits of π. It demonstrates the mathematical concept that since π is conjectured to be a normal number (containing all possible finite sequences), any arbitrary data theoretically exists somewhere within it.
problem_solved: Satirically 'solves' the problem of infinite data storage by using π as a universal compression mechanism.
why_valuable: Provides an entertaining and educational demonstration of π's mathematical properties (normal number hypothesis) and serves as a great conversation starter about infinite sequences, compression limits, and data theory.
